runtime_candidate.revision_status: Local uncommitted auth-recovery candidate based on source_revision; exact file hashes below. An explicitly requested release must pin the final committed backend revision.

behavior: Serialize host refresh through the existing private lock, including checks and manual refresh.
Allocate and fsync private recovery state before refresh; journal the issued replacement before SQLite commit, recover it after restart, preserve client/account identity and newer manual sign-ins.

Only absent setup or a confirmed unusable grant reports authentication required; temporary rejection, unknown refresh, configuration, permission and storage failures remain distinct unavailable states.
Back off after slow failure responses and bound confirmed-rejection attempts to three per fifteen-minute window; never automatically replay an uncertain rotation.
Recognize repaired grants without a sticky worker latch; preserve an independent durable quota hold until explicit operator resume.
Block model admission below 512 MiB free; retain all original research spools.
Preserve a pre-provider failed logical request and receipt with known zero provider calls, missing usage and no paid fallback.
Require held admission/polling and drained model work for native sign-in; stop the worker for exclusive grant ownership and restore its prior service state on CLI success or failure.

coverage: invalid grant quarantine and fresh sign-in
replacement recovery after SQLite commit failure
abrupt process exit after journal fsync
reject stale recovery slot from a prior rotation
actual helper output omits secret-bearing error text
backoff begins after a slow rejected response

private_dispatch_database.scope: Actual isolated PostgreSQL and service-only RPCs, synthetic provider/storage/auth/worker heartbeats.

release_maintenance_guards.scope: Mock AWS/Management API; actual local shell lifecycle with a synthetic systemctl executable, no real service actions.

infrastructure_jest.skip_reason: Existing benchmark CLI contract fixture not selected; unrelated to auth recovery.

checks.runtime_staging: All 35 declared source hashes verified locally; no assets uploaded.
checks.diff_whitespace: git diff --check passed in both changed repositories

limitations: Exposed development regressions, not independent held-out or human validation.
SDK refresh and provider errors use synthetic grants/responses; no real credential was inspected or refreshed.
Disk errors and failed commits are injected; the abrupt process exit and SQLite/lock operations are real local processes. A physical power cut or full production XFS filesystem was not tested.
An externally rotated grant that never reaches a durable local recovery record cannot be guaranteed recoverable; it is quarantined as uncertain, not silently retried or asserted expired.
The earlier production invalid_grant cause remains unproven. This fixes demonstrated design defects without claiming they caused that historical incident.
First upgrade must explicitly preserve any legacy quota hold, because the prior implementation held that state in memory.
Live production refresh, reconnect and authenticated queue recovery await an explicit release request; no deployment readiness claim for those conditional checks.

Frontend, SQL schema, public projection, model selection and published prompt pointers were not changed; no new frontend/browser or model-answer evaluation campaign applies to this local authentication change.

usage.unallocated: Local verification compute/storage and coding-agent usage are not metered by these application tests; missing usage/charges are not zero.
